correction: A build that can run on a tree it did not clean must pick the artifact as the file that did not exist before the build, never as the only file it happens to find: a wrapper that assumes an empty output directory turns one surviving file into the pipeline's ambiguity refusal (N artifacts matched <glob>; the version would be ambiguous). Report how many were seen before and after, and point at build.clean when the selection is not exactly one.
